description: This file defines an authentication context for a React application, including context creation, provider component, hooks, and utility functions for handling authentication state, environment variable resolution, and secure credential comparison.

methods.name: safeEquals
methods.description: Performs a time-safe string comparison by checking all characters and length in one pass to mitigate timing attacks.

methods.name: resolveExpectedCreds
methods.description: Resolves expected user credentials from environment variables, window object, or defaults for local development.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: React component that provides authentication state and actions (login, logout) via context, persisting state in localStorage.

methods.name: useAuth
methods.description: Custom hook to access authentication context.
